title: Comparison results for the $p$-torsional rigidity on convex domains
summary: For each open, bounded and convex domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^{D},$ $D\geq 2$, and each real number $p>1,$ we denote by $u_{p}$ the $p$\emph{-torsion function} on $Ω$, i.e. the solution of the \emph{torsional creep problem} $Δ_{p}u=-1$ in $Ω$, $u=0$ on $\partial Ω$, where $Δ_{p}u:=\operatorname{div}( \left\vert \nabla u\right\vert ^{p-2}\nabla u) $ is the $p$-Laplacian. Let $T_p(Ω)$ be the $p$\emph{-torsional rigidity} on $Ω$, defined as $T_{p}\left( Ω\right) :=\int_{Ω}u_{p}dx$.
